text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Urgh... It's the holidays again already?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! You got a ton of boxes again!
Sooo
many veggies!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tickezo. Can you take these off my
hands
for me?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What?! No way! Didn't your mom send
you
these?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Look, there's even a letter attached! You gotta eat them, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Fine... If I have to.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, no. It'd be way too much of a
pain to
cook all this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Better just share them with everyone at
school.
Tickezo, gimme a hand
tomorrow? I'm gonna give
it all to the
cafeteria lady.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Y-you can't do thaaat!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, Jordan's trainer! Please take these!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket leads Tosen Jordan into
my office
carrying a load of cardboard
boxes.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Here! Hope you enjoy them!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hot pot ingredients. My mom sent them
to me.
choice_data_list: What in the world is this...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: There's crab and stuff too. Help yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah. This is one of my mom's hobbies.
She sends
stuff to people and makes
them cook.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Even though she knows I don't like cooking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a variety of excellent ingredients
inside
the boxes, from carrots and napa
cabbage to
frozen seafood.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? We're just, like, average?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each ingredient is carefully wrapped,
and there's
a letter with instructions on
how to cook
everything in a microwave.
choice_data_list: So it's more for you than for your family, huh?
So it's more for you than for your family, then?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe... But still, what am I
supposed to
do with all this food?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan bends over and picks up
the letter
stuck to the top of one of the
boxes.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Enjoy all this delicious food"? I'm good.
The food
at the academy tastes fine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And I told her not to send me anything.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Want me to try cooking it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sure. Knock yourself out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as we've got all the ingredients, I
decide
to make a hot pot.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Finiiished!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It was looking pretty basic before. Like,
not very
seasonal of you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, speaking of. I wanna eat some
chicken. Let's
buy some.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Sure, if there's any left over.
choice_data_list: You're having some hot pot too, right?
You're having some hot pot too, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That was bussin'.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So you can cook too. Genius much?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, if my mom sends stuff again next
year, you
can cook that too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I don't mind if I'm just eating it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, speaking of. I wanna eat some
chicken. Let's
buy some.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Sure, if there's any left over.
choice_data_list: You're having some hot pot too, right?
You're having some hot pot too, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wow. So you just put the whole thing in?
That's
hilarious. Wingin' it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Save it. I know you're lying, 'cause my
mom hates
sloppy cooking. Admit it. It's
just too much of a
pain to cut it up,
right?
choice_data_list: Because that's what was written in the note...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yikes. Enough with the jokes already.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Here... I'll read it to you, 'kay? It says to
put the
water in the pot and add the
packet of broth.
Then...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Mmm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's funny eating hot pot like this with
you. Total
New Year's vibes.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... No way, just nope. This is so weird.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, sure. Thanks for cooking.
choice_data_list: But it was delicious, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Guess I should give my mom a ring. I'll
tell her we
ate it all together.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...And I'll tell her it was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Tosen Jordan calls her family
from my
office.
